writerPromptLaws: Be lively without laundering rumor into fact or manufacturing conflict, intimacy, scandal, or certainty.
Attribute claims about relationships, health, private conduct, wrongdoing, or disputed statements to the exact admitted source.
Do not confuse publicity material, fan speculation, anonymous social posts, and independent reporting.
Give the audience the promised factual payoff; curiosity may organize the headline but may not replace the answer.
invariants: Audience demand, attention, advertising, and revenue may select and fund a commission; they never supply factual warrant.
Every factual commitment must remain within admitted source evidence regardless of product cost, length, or urgency.
Collapse awareness is an available editorial perspective, never a subject-admission condition or compulsory frame.
A shorter product narrows the promised reporting task; it never weakens attribution, correction, privacy, harm, or fabrication gates.
